updates.title: Market Update
updates.content: The S&P 500 continues to test new highs, with the SPY ETF attempting to break through resistance levels. Technical indicators suggest a potential setup for further gains, but low volume and a lack of conviction from investors indicate caution.

updates.title: Current Developments
updates.content: Economists' predictions for the Fed's favorite inflation gauge, PCE, came as expected, with headline PCE at 0.0% and core PCE at 0.1%. Personal spending dropped, aligning with other data indicating a consumer pullback.

updates.title: Market Reactions
updates.content: Despite the positive technical setup, the stock market's significant distance from support zones and low volume have led to a lack of conviction among investors. The energy sector, however, has gained traction due to supply issues and record-breaking U.S. travel demand.

updates.title: Portfolio Strategy
updates.content: A diversified long-term investor should consider maintaining a balanced portfolio, with a focus on mega cap stocks, fossil fuel energy stocks, and technology sector ETFs, such as QQQ, which have historically outperformed the broader market.

updates.title: Looking Ahead
updates.content: Investors should keep a close eye on the presidential debate's impact on the American economy and U.S.'s international standing, as well as the potential effects of the AI rally on the tech sector.
